# Supplemental Tables {#sec-appendix-tables}

```{r}
#| label: setup-appendix-tables
source("_common.R")
```

This appendix demonstrates appendix numbering. Tables and figures in an appendix are numbered with the appendix letter, as in @tbl-app-sample.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-app-sample
#| tbl-cap: "Student participation by grade (simulated)"
set.seed(10)
grades <- c(3:8, "9", "10", "11", "12")
part <- data.frame(
  Grade = grades,
  Students = sample(7000:9800, length(grades)),
  Female = runif(length(grades), .31, .36),
  `English learner` = runif(length(grades), .06, .11),
  check.names = FALSE
)
gt(part) |>
  fmt_integer(Students) |>
  fmt_percent(c(Female, `English learner`), decimals = 1)
```
